title: Supply drinks in containers only under a refund scheme supply arrangement
what: A business that first supplies drinks in eligible containers in the state needs a supply arrangement with the scheme coordinator (under which it pays contributions that fund the refunds) and an approved, marked container before it supplies them.

laws.title: Waste Management and Resource Recovery Act 2016 (ACT)

sources.title: Waste Management and Resource Recovery Act 2016 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 64W(1) (current republication (R13, from 26 November 2025; Waste Management and Resource Recovery Act 2016 | Acts))
sources.quote: 64W Requirement for supply arrangement with scheme coordinator and container approval (1) A supplier commits an offence if— (a) the supplier supplies or offers to supply a beverage in a container to another person; and (b) the following are not in force: (i) a supply arrangement between the supplier and the scheme coordinator for the class of container to which the container belongs; (ii) a container approval granted

administration.who: Scheme coordinator of the ACT container deposit scheme
administration.note: The scheme coordinator is the person with whom the Minister enters into the scheme coordinator agreement.

assessment.summary: Beverage suppliers fund a 10-cent refund on containers. It prices litter and waste more fully, but each state runs its own scheme, with its own registration and costs, which weighs most on small and interstate suppliers.

marks.reason: Suppliers must register every container type and report and pay scheme costs.
Each state's scheme has its own registration and cost recovery, adding costs to selling in several states.
The deposit puts a price on littered and landfilled containers, a cost the market otherwise ignores.
